Switching primary vendor (memory c2) offered strong cost savings historically, but onboarding risk during a zero-slack production period is unacceptable given the primary objective of not increasing delivery risk, so I want to verify the original c2 record to check whether onboarding speed/quality held under tight timelines before ruling it out for a future cycle. I'm explicitly flagging that this renewal does not satisfy the finance mandate for an 18% spend cut this year — that gap must be addressed next cycle via negotiation, a multi-year volume commitment, or a second-source qualification, since only one sourcing action fits in this cycle.
